description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: focused Zaq.Engine.Connect.Mutations module and Connect facade delegates; narrowly scoped schema inspection redaction/encryption boundary hardening; focused real DB tests. Atomic credential create/update with explicit global instruction :keep or {:replace, material}; omitted instruction defaults keep, omitted config fields retain, replacement material is complete (empty/malformed rejects). Disabled/optional require locally usable canonical global grant; required permits absence. Usability checks status, configuration compatibility, required material, decryption and expiry only; no provider network authentication. Policy changes preserve Person rows. Reject authentication configuration changes while incompatible live canonical grants remain; cleanup first or compatible global replacement within atomic save. Trusted internal credential/owner-bound replace/revoke/remove reload and lock credential before slot, serializing absent slots; partial unique constraints final defense. Replacement retains ID and reactivates, revoke retains slot and clears secrets without authentication validation, removal deletes; cleanup is idempotent and permitted for missing/inactive Person. Creation/replacement checks literal active Person, no aliases or browser authorization. Nested transaction composition, no event emission (future .3). OAuth drafts/finalization explicitly DEFERRED to OAuth slice .6; accept pre-obtained OAuth material; no setup-state columns/framework. No resolver, Person UI/API transport authorization, OAuth network, lifecycle cleanup or runtime invalidation implementation.

Tests to add before implementation: policy/global-state matrix across auth kinds; atomic rollback including encryption errors; auth config changes and Person preservation; stale input reload; retained slot/reactivation; independent PostgreSQL replace/revoke/remove races including absent slots; nested outer rollback; nonexistent/inactive Person and cleanup; safe allowlisted results/errors, metadata rejection, enc:-prefix injection, malformed/empty/sentinel inputs and corrupt ciphertext; legacy regression; bounded property tests. No mocks of internals or networks. Real Repo/encryption, explicit runtime config/clock seams without global mutation. >=95% touched application file coverage or exact measured exceptions and follow-up.

Branches/paths validated: create/update/keep/replace/revoke/remove, required absence, disabled/optional global completeness, all status transitions, auth compatibility, canonical credential-owner binding, encryption rollback, literal active Person checks, cleanup with missing identity, stale schemas, malformed input and concurrency. Preserve .1 storage and legacy APIs/contracts.

Mocking plan: none; real PostgreSQL independent committed connections and encryption. Configuration through established Zaq.Config seam; expiry tests use explicit time at boundary.

Documentations to update: context/module contracts, docs/services/engine.md and system-config.md; repair missing decision-document reference if still present. Record exact commands/results and decisions here, mix format, mix q, focused tests/coverage, git diff --check. Delivery current workspace only; no commit/push/new worktree; remain in_progress pending independent review.

comments.text: Prerequisite .1 reviewed in current checkout: implemented storage is present at baseline 4474261a; git status --short clean. .1 remains in_progress pending review, not falsely closed. bw start refused open prerequisite; user explicitly approved .2, so claimed through bw update --status in_progress --assignee opencode without removing dependency. Available tools lack context-mode/Serena; using dedicated read/search/apply_patch and shell checks.

TDD first run: mix format && mix test test/zaq/engine/connect/mutations_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect/mutation_concurrency_test.exs exited 2: 12 tests + 1 property, 13 expected undefined API failures. First implementation rerun: 12 passed/1 test fixture name collision (required config already inserted), corrected fixture name. Added before further changes real encryption-config error rollback, exact expiry clock matrix, malformed retained-slot replacement, config secret omission/prefix, missing identity and nested failure tests. Decisions: explicit owners :org or {:person,id}; complete replacement clears omitted optional material; config omitted values retain, blank secrets reject; metadata only config auth_profile_id/subject, grant metadata unsupported. Auth-config changes reject all remaining active canonical slots except global being atomically replaced; inactive rows retain original auth fields. New API errors fixed atoms, replies IDs/status/policy only. SecretConfig encryption gets additive opts via Zaq.Config; nonce/tag lengths validated to prevent corrupt ciphertext crypto exceptions, no encryption-system rewrite.

Validation checkpoint: focused Connect + SecretConfig coverage run initially exceeded 120s after tests passed; harness timeout shutdown logged unrelated UpdateBadgeWorker sandbox ownership error. Unchanged rerun with 600s timeout exited 0: 166 tests + 2 properties, zero failures. Measured app coverage before final PEM refinement: Connect 195/204 (95.5%), Credential 20/20, Grant 25/25, Mutations 115/116 (99.1%), SecretConfig 44/44. mix q exited 0, 1185 files/94 checks/no issues. Extra security review found nonblank JWT garbage would count structurally usable: added malformed-PEM regression first, confirmed 1 failure, then added local private PEM decoding (RSA/EC) with fixed safe errors. Valid JWT fixtures now use generated real private keys. This is local material validation only, no provider auth. Docs updated with actual APIs, deferred OAuth draft/finalization, composition and legacy-locking limitations; removed missing decision-document link in favor of durable epic/.1 reference.

FINAL validation and review handoff (remain in_progress): final mix format && mix q exited 0, docs generated, Credo 1185 files / 94 checks / no issues. One intermediate mix q failed warnings-as-errors because SecretConfig moduledoc linked hidden Zaq.Config; replaced the hidden module link with runtime config seam wording, final gate passes. Final focused coverage underlying command: MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect test/zaq/engine/connect_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_token_edge_cases_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_encryption_error_test.exs test/zaq/system/secret_config_test.exs. Executed through Node child_process.spawnSync (550000ms timeout, 10MiB output buffer, preserves exit status; filters successful output to test totals/changed-file coverage). Exit 0: 169 tests + 2 properties, 0 failures. Tests took 24.2s. Measured touched app files: Connect 195/204 (95.5%), Credential 20/20 (100%), Grant 25/25 (100%), Mutations 120/122 (98.3%), SecretConfig 44/44 (100%). No below-target exceptions. Latest focused direct command mix format && mix test test/zaq/engine/connect/mutations_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect/mutation_concurrency_test.exs also passed before adding occupied-slot race variants: 18 tests + 1 property. Final coverage includes six independent PostgreSQL races (replace/revoke/remove on absent and occupied slots), all legacy storage/migration/Connect/OAuth tests, encryption rollback through per-call real config, nested success/abort rollback and malformed PEM rejection. Initial config failure test needed Code.ensure_loaded! for the test config provider because established Zaq.Config dispatch uses function_exported?; no global mutation introduced. Existing missing license_manager notice is nonfatal.

Delivery diff is entirely .2 relative to clean baseline 4474261a: new lib/zaq/engine/connect/mutations.ex, new test/zaq/engine/connect/{mutations_test,mutation_concurrency_test}.exs and test/support/connect_encryption_config.ex; modified Connect facade, Credential/Grant inspection redaction, narrow SecretConfig opts/nonce-tag validation, engine/system-config docs. Existing .1 schema/migration/tests preserved. No commit, push, PR, new worktree, events, resolver, transport authorization, OAuth draft/finalization/network, identity cleanup, or Agent invalidation. Browser E2E not applicable to trusted backend-only API; real DB tests verify reachable secret persistence. Parent independently reviews; .1 and .2 remain open/in_progress.

Review limitations: legacy writers and direct storage changesets remain trusted and do not participate in new mutation locks; canonical consumers must use the new boundary. Runtime encryption Ecto loads use normal application configuration; per-call config seam is used for encryption failure validation. Auth changes conservatively reject remaining active slots even if expiry has elapsed, requiring explicit cleanup; inactive rows retain original auth fields. Local JWT PEM parsing verifies a private-key structure, not provider acceptance. Concurrent Person deletion can still orphan grants per approved .1 decision; literal eligibility is checked before replacement without aliases. No events emitted, so outer composition cannot emit prematurely.
